integrity: The proof is unrestricted. It derives exact prime-power and two-prime-support formulas and a strict recursion under adjoining a coprime prime-power block. Finite computation is used only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines only the low spectrum through the sharp mixed-support value \(34\). It does not classify arbitrary fibers above \(34\).
title: Sharp \(34\)-barrier and low spectrum of \(\sigma_2(n)+\varphi(n)\sigma(n)-2n^2\)
